resources.title: What is DNS?
resources.cost: Free public reading; no certificate included.
resources.activity: Read the DNS caching section and write two sentences explaining why an outdated address could affect one device.
resources.why: Builds background for comparing the cache and resolver in this exercise.

resources.title: Explain a fix clearly
resources.activity: Write three sentences: the observed symptom, the action taken, and how you checked the result. Avoid unexplained acronyms.
resources.why: Practices a concise handoff without claiming to assess empathy.

resources.title: Build a diagnostic comparison
resources.activity: Create a two-column note comparing the affected device with a working device. List what each observation rules out and what it does not.
resources.why: Practices making the evidence behind an action explicit.
